final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT o.lunarstage AS c1, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS c2, COUNT(*) AS c3 FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(c2) AS c1 FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.c1 AS c1, s1.c2 AS c2, s1.c3 AS c3, s1.c2 - s2.c1 AS c4 FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.c1 IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.c2 > s2.c1) SELECT AVG(c2), SUM(c3), AVG(c4) FROM s3
